description: Find whether a product already exists in Amazon's catalog on the workspace's listing marketplace — by barcode (EAN/UPC/GTIN), by ASIN, or by keywords. Returns up to 10 matches with asin, title, brand, the product type and the first photo. A barcode match means publish_amazon_listings makes an OFFER on that item rather than a new product. Reads Amazon, never writes. Use search_products for the CRM's own catalog.

by.description: How to read query: barcode (8–14 digits), asin (e.g. B0ABCDEF12) or keywords (free text).

query.description: The barcode, ASIN or words to search for.

name: search_amazon_catalog
title: Search Amazon catalog
